def solution():
    # Define variables
    prices = [
        120, 122, 121, 124, 125, 127, 126, 129, 130, 128,
        131, 132, 134, 135, 137, 136, 138, 139, 140, 142,
        141, 143, 144, 146, 145
    ]
    period_ema = 10
    period_atr = 10
    multiplier = 1.5

    # Calculate the EMA
    ema = [sum(prices[:period_ema]) / period_ema]
    ema_multiplier = 2 / (period_ema + 1)

    for price in prices[period_ema:]:
        ema.append((price - ema[-1]) * ema_multiplier + ema[-1])

    # Calculate the ATR using the provided true-range logic
    price_changes = [
        high - low for high, low in zip(prices[1:], prices[:-1])
    ]

    atr = [sum(price_changes[:period_atr]) / period_atr]

    for change in price_changes[period_atr:]:
        atr.append(
            (atr[-1] * (period_atr - 1) + change) / period_atr
        )

    # Align the EMA and ATR series
    if len(ema) > len(atr):
        ema = ema[len(ema) - len(atr):]
    elif len(atr) > len(ema):
        atr = atr[len(atr) - len(ema):]

    # Calculate the final upper Keltner Channel band
    last_upper_band = ema[-1] + multiplier * atr[-1]

    # Return the answer rounded to two decimal places
    return round(last_upper_band, 2)
